theme_strategy: Light mode primary for trust and clarity (Doctolib inspiration), infused with deep contrast and a kinetic accent to assert a strong sports identity.

typography.headings: Cabinet Grotesk (Expressive, athletic, modern). DO NOT use Inter or standard sans for headings. Use font-black or font-light for contrast.
typography.body: Satoshi or IBM Plex Sans for ultra-clear readability, data density, and a reassuring feel.
typography.rules: H1 max text-5xl/6xl. Tight letter spacing for headings (tracking-tight). Overlines/Labels must be Uppercase + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).

colors.archetype: Hybrid: The Performance Pro + Organic Trust
colors.base: Bone White (#FAFAFA) and Pure White (#FFFFFF) to keep the 'Doctolib' cleanliness.
colors.primary: Deep Obsidian (#0A0A0A) for structural hierarchy and high-contrast trust.
colors.accent: Electric Blaze Orange (#FF4D00) or Volt Blue (#0055FF) for CTAs, kinetic energy, and active states.
colors.rules: No pure black or pure grey. Always tint greys slightly. Use APCA contrast. Interactive states must explicitly define hover text colors.

layouts.public_site: Generous spacing (p-8 to p-12). Asymmetry in the hero section to break the generic mold. Cards with subtle roundness (max 8px). The map should be a prominent visual element alongside the results.
layouts.back_office: High Density Grid (Bento style). Tight gaps (gap-4). Every pixel utilized for club managers. Data correlation is key.
layouts.components: Go flat and rectangular. Avoid heavy drop shadows; prefer 1px solid strokes (border-border/40) or subtle inner borders for definition.
layouts.forms: Use Shadcn forms. Custom styling for the 3-field search (Sport, Age, Zip Code 31xxx) to make it the hero centerpiece.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Solid Backgrounds with hard borders. No muddy glassmorphism for health/sports data to ensure absolute clarity.
visual_enhancers.motion: Use Lenis for smooth scrolling on the public site. Apply micro-interactions (e.g., hover: -translate-y-1, subtle scale) for cards and buttons.
visual_enhancers.icons: lucide-react for sharp, consistent UI. NO EMOJIS.

hero_and_cards.description: Aerial view running track - Good for subtle hero overlay or map context background.
Woman holding tennis racket - Use for individual sports club card.
Boy playing soccer - Use for kids/team sports club card.
Basketball training - Use for adult/indoor sports club card.

instructions_to_main_agent: Public Site: Build a highly visible hero search with 3 fields (sport dropdown, age range, zip code locked to 31xxx) and a 'Faire du sport' CTA.
Public Site Results: Implement a dual-view or split-screen for Club Cards and an Interactive Map (centered on Haute-Garonne, 31). Use mock markers if real coordinates aren't mapped.
Club Detail Page: Needs clear badges (ouvert/fermé/bientôt), price, slots, and an online registration/payment form.
Back-Office: Create a dense, data-rich dashboard for club managers. Include tabs/sections for info, slots, members, and subscriptions.
Auth & Routing: Implement JWT auth structures for both public participants and club managers. Differentiate the layouts.
Components: Deeply customize Shadcn UI components. Strip away the generic soft 'Vercel' look. Make buttons pill-shaped or sharp with athletic contrast.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add explicit transitions to properties like transform, background-color.
Ensure testability: apply `data-testid` to ALL interactive and key elements using kebab-case role-based naming.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Break the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Do NOT build generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical for the public site to create a premium, reassuring feel.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Ensure contrast compliance and explicit hover states (e.g., hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white).
